+def test_no_proxy_behavior(url, no_proxy):

+        bypass = should_bypass_proxies(url, no_proxy)
+        print(f"URL: {url}, no_proxy: {no_proxy}, bypass: {bypass}")
+    finally:
+        if "no_proxy" in os.environ:
+            del os.environ["no_proxy"]
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    # Case 1: Exact match
+    test_no_proxy_behavior("http://example.com", "example.com")

+    
+    # Case 5: Subdomain with port
